name: Sreekanth Radhakrishnan
description:
I'm a final-year Computer and Business Systems student at VIT Vellore, based in Chennai. The part of software I find most absorbing is the gap between a promising model and something people can rely on every day: the data wrangling, the safeguards, and the interfaces wrapped around it.

This summer I joined Xmplar as an Applied AI intern, where I worked on matching up financial records scattered across ERP exports and spreadsheets. We paired embeddings and language models with strict rule-based checks, so every match could be explained and verified. Before that I spent a summer at Adiyen Technologies on the product side, building live, multi-user Angular features backed by AWS serverless services.

NLP and retrieval are where I want to go deeper. I keep my problem-solving sharp on LeetCode, explore datasets on Kaggle, and unwind with a camera or a good pair of headphones. I'm currently looking for internships and full-time roles building applied AI products.
shortBio: Final-year B.Tech student at VIT Vellore who enjoys turning messy, real-world data into tools people can trust. Recently that has meant LLM-backed reconciliation for finance teams and real-time web apps on AWS.
